official_measurement_examples.name: EIA Schedule 1 rule
official_measurement_examples.fact: EIA PPG states Schedule 1 development requires Environmental Impact Assessment in every case.

official_measurement_examples.name: Schedule 2 screening semantics
official_measurement_examples.fact: Schedule 2 projects are screened for likely significant environmental effects; indicative thresholds do not alone decide the outcome.

official_measurement_examples.name: Screening opinion timing
official_measurement_examples.fact: EIA PPG says an LPA normally has 3 weeks for a screening opinion unless a longer period is agreed in writing.

official_measurement_examples.name: Scoping opinion timing
official_measurement_examples.fact: EIA PPG says an LPA normally has 5 weeks to provide a scoping opinion unless a longer period is agreed.

official_measurement_examples.name: Neighbourhood SEA toolkit date
official_measurement_examples.fact: MHCLG published neighbourhood-plan SEA screening guidance on 15 April 2026 and warns it has not yet been updated for recent planning-policy changes.

official_measurement_examples.name: NSIP HRA advice update
official_measurement_examples.fact: Planning Inspectorate HRA advice was updated 14 July 2026 and remains non-statutory process advice.

official_measurement_examples.name: HRA screening logic
official_measurement_examples.fact: Where likely significant effects cannot be excluded, the competent authority proceeds to appropriate assessment.

official_measurement_examples.name: Environmental agency advice update
official_measurement_examples.fact: Developer environmental-advice guidance was updated 1 July 2026 and distinguishes planning and environmental consents.
